question:
Select the most appropriate ANTONYM of the given word.

Astute
solution:
The correct answer is: **Stupid**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word **"Astute"** means having or showing an ability to accurately assess situations or people and turn this to one's advantage. (चतुर)

 
 
• **Example: **He was an astute businessman who could easily identify the best investment opportunities.
 
 
 
• **"Stupid" **refers to lacking intelligence or common sense. (मूर्ख)
 
 
• **Example: **It was stupid of him to forget the keys inside the car.
 
 
 
• Hence, we can infer that the opposite of **'Astute' **is **'Stupid'**.

Therefore, the correct answer is: **Stupid**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

 
• **Temporary **(अस्थायी): Lasting for only a limited period of time.

 
 
• **Example:** The temporary suspension of the service caused inconvenience to the users.
 
 
 
• **Illegal **(अवैध): Contrary to or forbidden by law.
 
 
• **Example: **Illegal activities such as smuggling are severely punishable.
 
 
 
• **Dispute** (विवाद): A disagreement or argument.
 
 
• **Example:** The land dispute between the neighbors has been going on for years.
